make.name: Chrysler
make.description: Chrysler is an American brand of Stellantis whose current range is the Pacifica minivan. It has shown electric concepts (Airflow, Halcyon) but has not yet sold a battery-electric car.

gaps: No battery-electric Chrysler has been sold. The Airflow concept (CES 2022) was turned into a production crossover project ('C6X', Wikipedia: Chrysler Airflow (2027)) planned for Belvidere around model year 2028, but its powertrain was put under review in 2025, so it is not listed as a BEV.
Chrysler Halcyon (Feb 2024) is a concept only, with 2028 named as the target for its design language.
Could not run a fresh web search on Chrysler EV plans (search budget exhausted); status per Wikipedia as of 2026.
